q1_issues.issue: (Measure sk_rise_1 price 1.83 dollar) records the AMOUNT OF INCREASE as the rise event's price, a dimension the sentence never states; with no licensed carrier for a delta, the instruction set's own guidance is to leave the modifier out rather than mis-slot it.

(To sk_rise_1 sk_close_1) applies the purposive-infinitive head to a RESULT infinitive ("rose $1.83 to close at $23.89"); To is licensed only for purpose, and the seeded bridge derives PurposeOf from it, asserting a goal the shares cannot have.

(Past sk_close_1) gives a non-finite embedded eventuality a tense atom, which the instruction set bars — a non-finite embedded eventuality "carries no tense/status atom of its own unless its own grammar marks one".

q2_gaps: a measured CHANGE in a value ("rose $1.83") — Measure is a static property, MoreBy compares two entities, and nothing records a delta on one entity across time

a time-indexed value measure ("closed Friday at $23.89") — Measure has no time slot, so the price must be hung either on the entity (losing the time) or on the event (losing whose price it is), as done here
a result / outcome infinitive ("rose ... to close at ...") — the connective section covers purposive "to" only
notes: The nominal side is right: the possessed plural takes a group witness with (Possession sk_shares_1 mcdonalds), the intransitive rise/close subject takes Patient per the non-volitional-process test, and the New York Stock Exchange gets one opaque name symbol plus a separate kind atom, with "on the NYSE" as an event-side Location.
